output_text:
import os
import base64
from google.cloud import documentai

def extract_key_values(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    project_id = config.get("project_id", os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT"))
    location = config.get("location", "us")
    processor_id = config.get("processor_id", os.environ.get("DOCUMENTAI_PROCESSOR_ID"))
    client = documentai.DocumentProcessorServiceClient()
    name = f"projects/{project_id}/locations/{location}/processors/{processor_id}"
    raw_document = documentai.RawDocument(content=payload, mime_type="application/pdf")
    request = documentai.ProcessRequest(name=name, raw_document=raw_document)
    response = client.process_document(request=request)
    document = response.document
    result = {}
    for entity in document.entities:
        if entity.type_ in ["key", "value"]:
            key = entity.properties[0].mention_text if entity.type_ == "key" and entity.properties else entity.mention_text
            value = entity.properties[0].mention_text if entity.type_ == "value" and entity.properties else ""
            if key and value:
                result[key] = value
    return result
